scenario.topic: Choose a data labeling strategy for a computer vision study

options.name: In-house Expert Labeling
options.upside: Ensures high-quality and consistent labels with domain experts directly involved.
options.concern: Requires significant time and resource commitment from skilled staff.

options.name: Crowdsourced Labeling Platform
options.upside: Faster labeling with flexible workforce and moderate cost.
options.concern: Label quality may vary, requiring additional validation steps.

options.name: Automated Pre-labeling with Human Verification
options.upside: Reduces human effort by combining automation and manual checks.
options.concern: Initial automated labels may introduce errors needing correction.

options.name: Outsourced Professional Labeling Service
options.upside: Delivers consistent, expert-level labeling without internal resource strain.
options.concern: Higher cost and less direct control over labeling process.

shared_context: A group of six researchers must select a data labeling strategy for a computer vision study requiring high accuracy and consistency. The options vary in cost, time, and required expertise, and all must support labeling at least 10,000 images.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a data scientist focused on scalable machine learning pipelines.
personas.private_goal: Wants a cost-effective and fast solution to meet project deadlines.

A.reason_for: High quality and consistency from experts is valuable.
A.reason_against: Too costly and time-consuming for current budget and timeline.

B.reason_for: Offers fast labeling at moderate cost and high scalability.

C.reason_for: Balances automation with human checks, reducing effort and cost.
C.reason_against: Quality is only medium and errors may need correction.

D.reason_for: Provides consistent expert labeling without internal resource drain.
D.reason_against: High cost and less direct control over the process.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a senior computer vision researcher emphasizing accuracy.
personas.private_goal: Seeks the highest label quality to ensure model reliability.

A.reason_for: Ensures high-quality, consistent labels from domain experts.

C.reason_for: Combines automation and manual verification for decent quality.
C.reason_against: Quality and consistency are only medium.

D.reason_against: Higher cost and less control than in-house.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina specializes in integrating AI-assisted tools into workflows.
personas.private_goal: Wants to leverage automation to reduce manual workload.

A.reason_for: High quality and consistency from experts.

B.reason_for: Fast and scalable with moderate cost.

C.reason_for: Reduces human effort by combining automation and verification.

D.reason_for: Consistent expert labeling without internal strain.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is a project manager overseeing large-scale labeling projects.
personas.private_goal: Prefers reliable, expert labeling with minimal internal disruption.

A.reason_for: High quality and consistency with expert involvement.
A.reason_against: Internal resource demands and slower speed.

B.reason_against: Variable quality and requires validation overhead.

C.reason_for: Good balance of automation and manual checks.
C.reason_against: Medium quality and some error correction needed.

D.reason_for: Expert-level consistent labeling outsourced, reducing internal load.

personas.name: Zara
personas.background: Zara is a junior researcher focused on rapid prototyping.
personas.private_goal: Needs a fast, affordable labeling approach to iterate quickly.

A.reason_against: Too slow and expensive for rapid iteration.

C.reason_for: Automation reduces manual effort and speeds process.
C.reason_against: Quality is only medium and errors may occur.

D.reason_for: Consistent expert labeling without internal resource use.
D.reason_against: Higher cost and slower than crowdsourcing.

personas.name: Omar
personas.background: Omar is a machine learning engineer with a focus on quality control.
personas.private_goal: Wants a balanced approach ensuring quality without excessive cost.

A.reason_for: High quality and consistency from experts.

B.reason_for: Fast and scalable with moderate cost.
